plan: chain plan v2: when our ball is not within 3 m of the action (chain S1 fails), is the right ball among the detector's candidates (a selection problem) or not (a detection problem)?
date: 2026-11-05, after chain.json and reading_ball_miss.json; before any computation below
data: the same 2,257 actions and their S1 from chain.parquet; the ball candidates of each unit's v3s_rows.parquet (the v3s detector's ~4 candidates per frame, frames 350-1075, every frame; the linked ball is always one of them), projected to pitch metres exactly as the pipeline does (src/pixel_scale.to_pitch_metres with the match's release calibration; checked identical on the linked rows)

per action, frames f - 4 .. f + 4.candidate near: some candidate within 3 m of the action's position
per action, frames f - 4 .. f + 4.top candidate near: in some frame, the candidate with the highest confidence is within 3 m

categories (of all actions).selection, top-1: not S1, and a top candidate near
categories (of all actions).selection, lower rank: not S1, a candidate near but never the top one

reported: the shares, overall, per action kind, per match; bootstrap over matches (5,000, seed 0) for selection (both) minus detection
reading rule: selection (both) larger than detection, with the interval of the difference above 0: work on selection and linking first (CPU, no retraining); detection larger, interval below 0: work on the detector first (GPU); otherwise both
